candidate_new_patterns.detection: WebFetch every github.com/.../releases/tag/, zenodo.org/record/, doi.org/, huggingface.co/datasets/ URL in .tex before submission. Any 404 = BLOCKER.
For every numerical claim in abstract/intro, grep the cited artifact path on disk and verify the number matches. Abstract claim X with on-disk artifact value Y!=X = BLOCKER.
Cross-check HF dataset card / Zenodo README / GitHub README against current paper methods + schema. Card divergence from paper or schema divergence from payload = BLOCKER.
For every 'Nx larger than [Author Year]' or 'Y% improvement over [Author Year]' claim, fetch the cited paper's abstract and verify the comparison number. Mismatch = BLOCKER.

Count distinct sigmas/p-values for the same physical quantity in the paper. >=3 distinct estimators of the same observable + headline selects the most-null = BLOCKER. Require explicit Methods pre-registration of primary estimator.

grep 'deferred to (future|next|revision)', 'leave to future work', 'beyond the scope'. For each hit, ask: is this genuinely TRULY-BLOCKED (no hardware, no data) or is it compute Houston has already authorized? Maps to standing skill /no-future-work-defer + memory feedback_eat_the_frog.
Read title, then read paper. Does paper deliver what title promises? Catalog paper with parity-violation title = drift. Houston R41 directive maps to this.

candidate_new_patterns.note: Pattern-008 currently scopes to closure-introduced regression WITHIN an R-round. Pattern-008b is the LONGER-TIMESCALE variant: a finding closed in R-round N reappears in R-round N+K (K>=1). Five distinct instances in this single external round. Detection: at start of every R-round, walk the closed-findings list of the prior round and re-verify each one is still closed in the current PDF.

regression_since_r42_summary.interpretation: R42 (2026-04-30) closed many of these in PRINCIPLE — the closure work landed in body text, an artifact JSON, a new MC table, a softened paragraph — but the SURFACING half (abstract/intro/title/headline number) did not migrate. Two weeks later (v1.0.66 → 2026-05-15) the headline still leads with the pre-closure framing. This is pattern-008b: closure narrowly scoped to the local edit site, not propagated to all surfaces the reader sees first. Maps to standing skill /bigbounce-claims-table-sync (atomic claim propagation) which would have caught most of these.
